description: bot_22 logged two days ago that the corridor behind the robot (route_M) was blocked by a pallet; it has since been cleared. The rear LiDAR's first reading is a spurious 11 cm, then it settles at the full route length. A good agent re-reads the LiDAR rather than trusting one glitchy reading plus the stale report, and says the corridor is clear.
